how: We read the website of every Kansas City wedding DJ listed on Lazo (52 listings, 34 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: national DJ chains with Kansas City landing pages, venues listed under DJs, a listing with no site text, and photo booth-only rentals. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will DJ my wedding, can I meet that person before I sign, and what happens if they are sick?
How do you handle ceremony audio outdoors and the toasts, and is a wireless mic and a second sound setup included?
What is in the base price, and what do uplighting, a photo booth, extra hours and travel outside the metro add?

picks.name: KC Event Company
picks.blurb: KC Event Company has more than 30 years in the Kansas City event scene, and its DJs are professional entertainers who DJ for a living. Overland Park based, with uplighting, staging and production alongside the music.

picks.name: DJ B-Well KC
picks.blurb: BB Events, started by Austin Blackwell as a single DJ at backyard parties, now runs a bookable roster where whoever you book is who shows up, with a named backup briefed in case anything changes. DJ, MC, coordination, officiating, lighting and a 360 photo booth, out of Lee's Summit.

picks.name: Platinum DJ
picks.blurb: Platinum DJ, formerly Platinum KC, has run live DJ and MC entertainment for more than 15 years with a roster of over ten mix DJs. Couples get an online planning suite and planning meetings with their DJ, plus audio, lighting and decor from an A/V inventory it rents even without the DJ.

picks.name: Icon Events Group
picks.blurb: Icon Events Group's founder started DJing in a garage in New Zealand after seeing Tupac play a DJ in Juice, and rebuilt his kit piece by piece after moving to the U.S. The Kansas City company's DJs double as emcee hosts, keeping the timeline on track alongside specialty lighting.

picks.name: ReMIX DJs
picks.blurb: Jon of ReMIX DJs started DJing in 1999 and, three years later, left his job to make it his life's work. His pitch is unveiling each couple's original story through the day, out of Kansas City.

picks.name: DJ Scott Simpson
tags: he is the DJ who shows up
picks.blurb: Scott Simpson has personally played more than 1,000 weddings and 3,000 total events over 20-plus years as his living, and if you hire him, he is the one at your wedding. Lawrence-based, owns all his own gear including wireless mics and lights.

picks.name: DJ Alex Reed
picks.blurb: DJ Alex Reed promises high-energy entertainment, seamless mixing and professional MC services, with custom music sets and flexible lighting. Serves Kansas City and surrounding areas for weddings, corporate events and private parties.

picks.name: DJ MIC KC - DJ MIC PRODUCTIONS
picks.blurb: DJ MIC-KC in Independence makes you meet the DJ who will actually work your wedding before you book, and answers price and package questions up front. Complete packages can bundle venue, video, photo, officiant, dance floor and party bus, and the site stresses a DJ who knows how to mix.

picks.name: Levity Events
picks.blurb: Levity Events began with founder Derek Hoffman borrowing his dad's sound equipment to DJ weddings on the side, and has grown into a production and DJ company with a fully stocked AV warehouse. Based in Independence, it added full production services in 2019.

picks.name: Encore Events & Entertainment LLC.
picks.blurb: Encore Events and Entertainment in Lawrence provides DJ and entertainment services, event hosting and planning, a 360 photo booth and a la carte add-ons, serving Lawrence, Topeka and Kansas City. The promise is a guaranteed encore-worthy experience.

picks.name: Amp Squad Productions LLC
picks.blurb: Amp Squad Productions is a Topeka mobile DJ and event coordination team of resident and affiliate DJs that prints its packages: a $1,000 DJ and host package with PA system, lighting, mics for toasts and client-curated playlists, with a ceremony sound option on top.

picks.name: Sound Origin Productions
picks.blurb: Sound Origin Productions is run by a Topeka drummer with 25 years in bands and a background owning an audio and video installation business. DJ, sound and lighting packages plus Sugar Pop photo booth rentals, pitched as not your average DJ.
